text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hawawawa... F-F-First place, for meee!? 
How could that even happen~?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Th-Th-This must be a dream, surely. Let me 
pinch my cheek and see!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ow, ow, ow, ow, ow, oww!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-It actually hurts...! T-T-Then does that 
mean this is a prank!?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
People holding placards will just suddenly 
pop out of nowhere, right?! Tell me I'm 
right!!
choice_data_list: We can't just be celebrating all day.

text_block_list.text:
People holding placards will just suddenly 
pop out of nowhere, right?! Tell me I'm 
right!!
choice_data_list: We can't just be celebrating all day.
We can't just be celebrating all day.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Hard work really does pay off sometimes, 
doesn't it? Even if it's just a fluke, I'm 
sooo happy~."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"A-And taking it back later saying it was 
just a lie is not allowed, okay...? Um, 
you won't do that, right?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I told her it was all right, Meisho 
Doto grinched from ear to ear for the rest 
of the day.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Y-You're right...! I feel like I'm 
floating on air~
choice_data_list: Let's refocus and get fired up again!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hai-ee...! That's right, there's still a 
next time...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"I need to train more, study more... and 
then, and then...!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I won't lose... no, I want to 
win! I-I'm gonna do this~~!!
